# Prince Juguilon Developer Resources

Use this scoped index for integration questions about the Prince Juguilon Portfolio API.

- OpenAPI: https://prince.juguilon.com/openapi.json
- REST index: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1
- Portfolio MCP: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/mcp
- Documentation MCP: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/mcp/docs
- Authentication: https://prince.juguilon.com/auth.md
- API catalog: https://prince.juguilon.com/.well-known/api-catalog

All operations are public, anonymous, GET-only or read-only, idempotent, and non-destructive.
